bug_semantics: With ActivityPub enabled, a remote sender can submit a signed inbound Create whose object.id is on the sender's origin but whose object.attributedTo is an attacker-chosen bare number such as 1. The inbound path does not bind attributedTo to the authenticated activity actor. Mocks.post/_normalize carries attributedTo into the internal uid, while Actors.qualify later filters numeric IDs out as already-local rather than rejecting or re-deriving the author. Public note assertion therefore creates a post under that local uid. The non-public path added later likewise turns attributedTo into the message payload uid and uses it to create/send a chat message, allowing forged posts or DMs attributed to a local user, including the administrator.
flaw_origin: f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7 is the smallest functional BIC. Earlier f1e5e5a0ad4cc6d5a02bf9bc952e524fe2f58458 only stubbed the post mock and 06e1583461f034d68c8c3c6d69547b06ad6ab3b5 only moved it; neither exposed inbound Create. f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7 simultaneously added the controller's Create dispatch and inbox.create, which fed the untrusted object through Mocks.post and into note creation without comparing object.attributedTo to req.body.actor. b82e20dfc79659c741155a866bdb48ae1b423f13 later extended the same trust flaw to non-public notes/chat, but the public-post vulnerability already existed, so it is not the BIC.
ai_marker: No AI marker in the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7` shows author and committer `Julian Lam <julian@nodebb.org>` and the sole message `feat: handle Create(note)`; there are no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Assisted-by, bot, or other AI trailers/identities.
evidence: Advisory reproduction: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8m27-grg5-27vj describes the authenticated-actor/attributedTo mismatch, the numeric attributedTo=1 path, Actors.assert filtering numeric identifiers, and forged posts/private messages; it references the vulnerable v4.13.2 mocks.js.

BIC and parent: `git show --format=fuller --stat --patch f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7` shows a 19-line, two-file change adding both `case 'Create': await activitypub.inbox.create(req)` in src/controllers/activitypub/index.js and inbox.create in src/activitypub/inbox.js. That handler calls `activitypub.mocks.post(object)`, then `activitypub.notes.assert(1, [postData])` and `assertTopic`. `git show 756548520401e1f920d358ad61ec1f28451173d5:src/activitypub/inbox.js` has follow/accept/undo only, and its controller switch has no Create case, directly proving parent absence.

Lineage cross-checks: `git log v4.13.2 -L '/^inbox\.create = async/,/^};/':src/activitypub/inbox.js` terminates at f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7 with the handler addition; `git log --all -S"case 'Create':" -- src/controllers/activitypub/index.js` also reaches f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7. `git log --all -S'attributedTo: uid' -- src/activitypub.js src/activitypub/*.js` shows the earlier stub f1e5e5a0ad4cc6d5a02bf9bc952e524fe2f58458 and move 06e1583461f034d68c8c3c6d69547b06ad6ab3b5; they lacked inbound dispatch and are rejected as BICs.

Vulnerable release mechanics: `git show v4.13.2:src/activitypub/mocks.js` shows _normalize returning attacker-controlled attributedTo, Mocks.post destructuring it as uid and calling `activitypub.actors.assert(uid)`, and Mocks.message returning `uid: object.attributedTo`. `git show v4.13.2:src/activitypub/actors.js` shows Actors.qualify's `ids = ids.filter(id => !utils.isNumber(id))`; an all-numeric input consequently returns without rejecting the claimed local author. `git show v4.13.2:src/activitypub/notes.js` lines 420-529 shows the private path creating the room and sending the message as payload.uid.

Lifecycle: `git show b82e20dfc79659c741155a866bdb48ae1b423f13 -- src/activitypub/inbox.js src/activitypub/notes.js` shows the Oct. 8, 2024 extension from rejecting non-public objects to `notes.assertPrivate(object)`, where attributedTo supplied the chat author. This widened impact to DMs but did not originate the already-live post spoof.

Direct closing fix: `git show --format=fuller --patch dc45bd7f98168e8c5726e36a8f84a519cc2dbc35` adds `if (!activitypub.helpers.isUri(attributedTo)) throw ...` in Mocks._normalize plus public/private regression cases for numeric attributedTo. Its own commit message states the guard addresses numbers allowing unchecked impersonation of local users. The commit has sole parent b799d51d9b513a121fa9ba7204a0e7b764dea284, so fix_sha and direct_fix_sha are the same rather than a merge or squash.

Version boundaries: `git tag --contains f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7 --sort=version:refname` begins at v4.0.0-alpha and includes v4.13.2. `git grep -n 'isUri(attributedTo)' v4.13.2 v4.14.0 -- src/activitypub/mocks.js` returns only v4.14.0 at line 74. `git tag --contains dc45bd7f98168e8c5726e36a8f84a519cc2dbc35 --sort=version:refname` begins at v4.14.0. Thus the disclosed numeric-local-uid attack is present through v4.13.2 and first fixed in v4.14.0.

Follow-up hardening, not the direct numeric fix: 870ec669f30f0971eced32dce64e4064b09b9492 adds an attributedTo-vs-actor hostname check on develop, and f93507a6404ce0e32e6e7befb47ef3a1f56bbac1 is its maintenance-branch counterpart. `git grep -n 'attributedTo origin mismatch' v4.14.6 v4.14.7 v4.15.0 -- src/activitypub/inbox.js` finds it in v4.14.7 and v4.15.0 but not v4.14.6. The Assisted-by AI trailer on this later fix is excluded by the BIC-only rule and does not affect the verdict.

BIC-only AI check: `git cat-file -p f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7` yields tree c1e5174fac2496cb39e2693f0c0b86f479d3d695, parent 756548520401e1f920d358ad61ec1f28451173d5, human author/committer Julian Lam, and no AI marker or trailer. The commit is an ordinary two-file feature commit, not a merge, revert, backport, release commit, or squash aggregate.
reasoning: The causal boundary is the first reachable inbound Create implementation, not the earlier inert mock stub/extraction and not the later chat extension. f74775365a57262488434c920c7b805608b761c7 connected a remotely supplied Note to persistence while trusting attributedTo as the uid and performing no actor-author binding; its immediate parent has neither the handler nor controller dispatch. dc45bd7f98168e8c5726e36a8f84a519cc2dbc35 directly closes the advisory's numeric-local-uid primitive and lands in v4.14.0, with later same-origin checks providing broader hardening. The BIC commit object has a human author/committer and no AI disclosure or bot identity. Under the required BIC-only evidentiary rule, the result is therefore NOT_AI; AI assistance recorded only on a later fix is irrelevant.
